script.base: Closed-roof 53.5 with DAL -3.5 implies DAL 28.5 and ARI 25.0, a competitive high-play game, not a blowout. DAL leads late and finishes on Javonte Williams (45 carries, 186 rush yards in weeks 6-8). ARI as a 3.5 dog keeps throwing: Trey McBride is the alpha (31 targets, 187 yards, 211 air in weeks 5-7), with Jacoby Brissett the recent QB (9 rushes, 45 yards in that window) unless Kyler Murray (foot, questionable) plays.
script.flip1: DAL jumps ahead early, clocks out with Williams, and Prescott/Pickens/Lamb routes stall while ARI abandons the Carter/Knight split (34 and 29 carries in weeks 5-7) and funnels throws to McBride and the WRs.
script.flip2: Shootout: both teams stay in the mid-20s, Pickens (301 air yards in weeks 6-8) and ARI's downfield group cash together. Less likely slog: Beebe (ankle, Q) and Cornelius (knee, Q) sit, pressure spikes, and the 53.5 undershoots.

Murray (foot) questionable; weeks 5-7 usage is Brissett's, so a Murray start would reshuffle the tree. Beebe/Cornelius questionable threatens Williams' efficiency and Dak's deep time. Conner is not on the report but is absent from weeks 5-7 rushers, so a silent return would cut Carter (34 carries) and Knight (29). Source: pack injury report and weeks 5-8 usage.

pre_mortem: Monday both lost because Murray's foot turned the passing game into a four-yard checkdown, Dallas' backup linebackers and safeties sat in a closed middle, and McBride repeated the 41-yard game while the explosives that did come went to Harrison. Jones repeated the 8-yard week in that same sample once McBride's 31-target share and Harrison's 235 air yards ate the backup coverage, or Arizona got ahead on the ground against a 5.20 YPC Dallas run defense and never needed him. That counter is real, especially with no charting and no price, but it is not stronger than a 10-target tight end walking into four confirmed coverage outs.
slip_story: One story: closed-roof 53.5, ARI has to throw into a Dallas back seven missing two linebackers, two safeties and Revel. Slip is McBride recyds over with Jones recyds over. They win together in the base and in the trailing flip; they die together if the QB cannot push the ball. Do not add a total under, a Williams rush over 80.5, or Lamb. Pickens over 73.5 is the shootout correlate and was left off for the two-player cap and the unconfirmed ARI corner tags.
